text: Remote work has changed the modern workplace completely. Employees get much more flexibility, so you can work and still look after your life. It's also good for businesses, since they can recruit from anywhere and save money on premises. But it's not easy. Communication breaks down and teams lose each other. Some workers struggle to get away from work once they go home. It feels lonely sometimes. So it really comes down to policy. Leaders need to set ground rules and make sure the team is connected despite the lack of physical contact.
